digest.component_or_area: plan-review prompt caching and Pass-1/Pass-2 system prompt architecture
propositions: Pass-1 finder and Pass-2 verifier system prompts must begin with an identical byte-prefixed plan block (shared_plan_prefix) to enable provider-side cache reuse within Anthropic's 5-minute TTL

The reviewing stance preamble, including a new exhaustiveness directive for incremental-depth BLOCK loops, must be single-sourced in prompts.py and present in every Pass-1 entry point (finder, container, ISF) to prevent drift and enforce invariants

Plan text must move from verifier user message to verifier system prompt (via shared_prefix), while finding listings remain in user turn as base_instructions, eliminating the volatile marker from verifier templates
Pass-1 warm-gate cache-floor check must measure the actual bytes sent (shared_plan_prefix token count) rather than plan-only, via pass1._prefix_tokens() helper
plan_review_verify_inputs output must emit shared_prefix in place of plan, and both plan-review.yaml verify steps must wire shared_prefix from outputs to render variables
plan-review-verifier must be removed from RELOCATED_PROMPTS because verifier templates no longer carry the volatile marker after this restructuring
